text:
olivia: Heads-up from today's design critique — the help link in the top-right panel currently says 'Docs' but the sidebar uses 'Guides' elsewhere. Customers are getting mixed signals. Screenshot: https://mock.redwood.test/screenshots/help-link-confusion.png :eyes:

sam: Ugh yeah. We renamed things during the nav revamp and missed a few spots. Which one do we standardize on?

jess: Vote: 'Guides' for learning content (how-tos), 'API reference' for the spec, and 'Model docs' for model-specific pages. But the panel is contextual, so maybe 'Guides' feels too broad.

olivia: Proposal: change the panel link to 'Model docs' when the panel is model-related, and 'Guides' for workflow pages. That requires a small piece of context-aware copy. Also ensure link text is descriptive (no lone 'Docs').

docs-bot: I can update redirects and add a canonical label map in the docs repo. Draft PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/87. Will hold until UX approves.

theo: Accessibility note: current anchor has `aria-label="open docs"` which is not descriptive. Use something like `aria-label="Open model docs in a new tab"` and add `target=_blank rel=noopener` when opening external docs. Also add `role="button"` if it's styled as a button.

jess: Thanks @theo. Also add a visually-hidden element with the panel context so screen-reader users hear "Model docs, related to Model X" when the panel opens.

olivia: Another small ask: track clicks separately for inline panel links vs footer help button. Product wants to know if users prefer inline contextual help. Can we add a data attribute or an event category?

docs-bot: Yes. I'll add data-help-source: `panel-inline` | `panel-footer` to links and we can feed that into the analytics pipeline.

rachel: From implementation: the panel is a shared component used in Settings and Deploy flows. We should keep the props minimal: `helpLabel`, `helpHref`, `helpSource`. We also need a keyboard shortcut clue (e.g., `?`) that appears in the header for power users.

olivia: Action items:
- @jess finalize copy variants for 'Model docs' vs 'Guides' by EOD
- @docs-bot hold PR 87 until copy locked
- @theo add suggested aria-label examples to the shared component docs
- @rachel add analytics hook and `data-help-source` to the component

sam: Small moderation: prefer concise link text but include long description in `aria-label`. Example: `Link text: "Model docs"; aria-label: "Open model docs for Redwood-internal/gpt-small (opens in new tab)"`

olivia: Love that. Let's sync tomorrow at 10am in design channel to approve the final mock and run quick keyboard-only checks. Thanks all :sparkles:
